coverage_notes: Exactly 12 targeted web searches were used, bounded to the prior-hour recall window and the four audited high-value miss classes.

Searches prioritized fresh local news and official/provider notices for sole/last/full-service grocery loss, emergency distribution cancellation or suspension, abrupt pantry/food-bank access reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption.
Fresh results included Hawaiʻi storm-impact updates and unrelated or older SNAP/EBT items, but none documented a new qualifying food-access disruption in the bounded window.
Donation drives, resource guides, routine promotion, opinion, generic inflation stories, non-U.S. items, older events, and duplicates were excluded.
Production collection remains authoritative; this run is supplementary only.
